name: Kyoto
birthText: Temple bells carry over the rooftops of the old capital on the night you are born.
description: An old city of shrines and quiet back streets, where some families have kept the same secrets for a thousand years.

name: London
birthText: Fog presses against the hospital windows as you take your first breath.
description: A sprawling capital of fog and stone, home to more mage lineages than anyone outside them suspects.

name: Prague
birthText: Snow falls on the hundred spires of the city the night you arrive in the world.
description: A city of alchemists' lanes and astronomical clocks, where old magic soaks into the stones.

name: New Orleans
birthText: A brass band is playing somewhere down the street when you are born.
description: A humid river city of music, cemeteries above the ground, and a living folk magic that the mage world tends to underestimate.

name: Buenos Aires
birthText: The river wind rattles the shutters of your family's house on the night of your birth.
description: A grand port city of wide avenues and old money, built by people from every corner of the world, each bringing their own traditions.
